intro: Bring energy to your room with Raffin swivel chair. Its cushioned seat, 360° swivel, and modern finish keep you moving freely, working comfortably, and relaxing in a chair that uplifts your day.

features.title: 360° swivel that keeps you fluid
features.text: Turn with ease while working, chatting, or reaching for things around you, making everyday movements smoother and more effortless.

features.title: Cushioned comfort you feel instantly
features.text: Soft padding supports your seat and back so you stay comfortable through long hours, whether you’re at your desk or unwinding with coffee.

features.title: Compact shape for versatile use
features.text: Sized to fit neatly in work nooks, bedrooms, or living spaces, giving you flexibility to use it where you need without crowding the room.

features.title: Mint green that refreshes your space
features.text: The lively mint tone adds brightness and a playful edge, lifting your interiors with a fresh, modern vibe that feels inspiring every time.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
